events.terms_source: Ratio (1 equity share of Re 1 + 4 preference shares of Rs 10 per Cairn share), record date 27-Apr-2017 and allotment on 28-Apr-2017: Vedanta allotment letter to NSE/BSE https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/VEDLOutcomeOfAllotmentCommitteeMeeting28April2017_28042017140052_171.zip; record date intimation: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/VEDLEffectivenessOfMerger_12042017180423.zip; scheme effective 11-Apr-2017: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/VEDLEffectivenessOfMerger_11042017190432_700.zip; NSE notice (13-Apr-2017) suspending trading in Cairn India w.e.f. 26-Apr-2017 i.e. closing hours of 25-Apr-2017, and NSE corporate-actions API (CAIRN 'Scheme Of Arrangement' ex-date 27-Apr-2017); preference ISIN INE205A04011 from NSE notice of 15-Oct-2018 suspending trading in the preference shares for redemption.
events.notes: Scheme of Arrangement between Cairn India and Vedanta (NCLT Mumbai order 23-Mar-2017, effective 11-Apr-2017); terms are the revised July 2016 terms (1 equity + 4 RPS), not the original 2015 terms (1 equity + 1 RPS) in the 2015 NSE scheme filing. Ex-date set to 26-Apr-2017 by the T+2 rule (one trading day before record date 27-Apr-2017), consistent with NSE suspending Cairn trading w.e.f. 26-Apr-2017; the NSE corporate-actions API lists the ex-date as 27-Apr-2017 (the record date) since no trading occurred. Shares held by Vedanta and its subsidiaries were not exchanged. Preference shares: 7.5% non-cumulative non-convertible redeemable, Rs 10 face value, 18-month tenure, listed on NSE/BSE, redeemed Oct 2018 (record date 22-Oct-2018); their listing date was not confirmed (null). No company cost-of-acquisition split between equity and preference shares was found, so equity gets 100 and preference 0 per the filling rules. Vedanta was formerly Sesa Sterlite / Sesa Goa.
